title: Dillon Thieneman’s first NFL interception couldn’t have come at a better time

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Dillon Thieneman’s first NFL interception couldn’t have come at a better time
sources.description: Chicago Bears rookie Dillon Thieneman just came up big. The first-round safety’s first career interception couldn’t have come on a more clutch occasion: swiping Philadelphia Eagles quarterback Andy Dalton in the red zone to take away a potential touchdown and maintain the Bears’ 7-0 lead in the second quarter.
